_comment: Symmetric zero-pi (scqubits ZeroPi with dEJ = dCJ = 0), varphi_ext = 2*pi*flux:
2 E_CJ n_phi^2 + 2 E_CS (n_theta - n_g)^2 - 2 E_J cos(theta) cos(phi - varphi_ext/2) + E_L phi^2 + 2 E_J.
2 E_CJ n_phi^2 -> E_C[phi,phi] = E_CJ/2; 2 E_CS n_theta^2 -> E_C[theta,theta] = E_CS/2; E_L phi^2 -> E_L[phi,phi] = 2*E_L.
-2 E_J cos(theta) cos(phi - x) = -E_J cos(theta + phi - x) - E_J cos(theta - phi + x), x = varphi_ext/2.
constant 2*E_J: scqubits ZeroPi.sparse_potential_mat adds 2 E_J to the potential.
Offset-charge sign: scqubits ZeroPi uses 2 E_CS (n_theta + n_g)^2; this file uses (n_theta - n_g)^2, the transmon convention.
The two Hamiltonians are complex conjugates of each other in the charge/position basis (time reversal), so their spectra coincide.
